avatars.prompt:
ONE ORIGINAL FAN ART PROFILE PORTRAIT of the male IOP / YOPUKA from DOFUS. The attached references are three views of his actual game model. Keep him immediately recognizable as THIS Dofus class: tall flame-shaped tangerine-orange hair, the characteristic long cheek-framing orange side locks, long pointed ears, tan slim angular face, expressive solid-white pupil-less eyes, bone-white sleeveless tunic with teal-blue neck/armhole edging and large dark red stylized sword/cross on chest, single rounded crimson pauldron. Keep these design features and exact local clothing colors. Do not redesign as generic fantasy, do not add a cape or scarf, do not borrow characters from other games.
The creative brief is a PERSONALITY-FILLED FAN DRAWING, combining an inventive expressive pose with an unmistakably crafted INK AND WATERCOLOR finish. Like a beautiful original drawing from a character illustrator's sketchbook, digitally finished but retaining its drawing decisions.
NEW POSE AND EXPRESSION: the Iop leans a little toward the viewer, shoulders turned one way and head turned back toward us, with a bold lopsided cheeky grin showing just his upper teeth, one eye squinted slightly more than the other, exuberant slightly foolish bravery. He is casually resting his oversized sword across the BACK of his shoulders; only a simple section of blade and guard behind him should be visible. The sword must not cross or hide his face. Convey a lively affectionate understanding of Iop personality. Three-quarter eye-level portrait, not the game's top-down camera or idle stance. Slightly exaggerated lively original Dofus comic anatomy, prominent expressive ears, face drawn with charm and asymmetry. Composition for a profile photo: ONE head-and-shoulders character, face near center, tall hair fully contained with empty space above, face and hair read inside central circular crop. Shoulders can run out at bottom.
DRAWING LANGUAGE: visible lively dark graphite preliminary strokes in a few places, confident tapered black brush-pen ink with a mix of hairline marks and heavier expressive contour, a few selective hatch marks. Actual linework should be the beauty of the picture. Hand-placed loose watercolor fills with occasional small unfilled paper gaps near ink edges, beautiful limited colors, natural varied watercolor edges; quiet matte finish. Keep the planes SIMPLE, crisp shapes on the main silhouette and loose little drawn decisions inside. Color slightly understated, not fluorescent. Background is clean warm off-white with one restrained loose desaturated teal watercolor wash behind the character, irregular and unobtrusive. No artificial all-over grain filter, no grunge overlay, no brown paper, no perfect vector lines or mechanically uniform edge, no over-rendered digital painting, no plastic or 3D, no gloss, no cinematic glow, no rim lighting, no airbrushed gradients, no sparks, no over-detailed hair strands, no decoration or fake handwritten notes. The drawing should feel FUN, OBSERVED, CHARACTERFUL, PERSONAL, not a polished generic AI avatar or tracing of the reference.
Square opaque image. Single character only, not a sheet, no collage, no frame, no text, no signature, no watermark, no lettering.
